data.content_ref: inline:The problem 061ddfcce3bb integrates with SRC_005 by proposing that the 'genuine reliability' versus 'mere compliance' distinction is actually a measure of the 'Checklist-Task Fit' in open-world environments; specifically, compliance tracks the right answer in closed worlds, while genuine reliability (expert intuition) is required for open worlds. This relation is refuted if the distinction between compliance and reliability persists even in perfectly closed-world verifiable tasks.
